note: Which source feeds each score metric when a company is ranked inside a sector. One source is chosen per metric for every company in the comparison: the first candidate covering at least min_coverage of the set. A metric with no qualifying source is not scored. pool_store = pool_metrics.json (our own calculation from Yahoo prices and NSE filings, built daily); nse_marketlens = NSE Market Lens rows. Market Lens fields not listed here are placeholders (return on equity, growth, beta) or absent (drawdown, EV, cash flow).
